title: RSF Drone Strike on University Dormitory Kills Five in El Obeid
detail: A drone strike attributed to the Rapid Support Forces hit a university dormitory in El Obeid, North Kordofan, on October 1, 2026, killing five civilians and wounding 47, per Sudan Tribune. El Obeid has faced repeated drone strikes since June, with worsening water shortages and a cholera outbreak reported amid the pressure on the city.
